messages:
Pri: Quick giveaway  free single-arm desk mount (VESA 75/100) + one short DP cable. Moving on Saturday, pickup SF office bench by Friday 5pm. Pics: https://imgur.com/pri-arm :handshake:
Ola: Interested! Is it gas-spring or friction?
Pri: Gas-spring, smooth. Rated ~9kg. Has small paint chip near clamp.
Ben: I can take the cable if you want to hold the arm for Ola. I need a spare for my travel dock.
Pri: Ben, sure. I'll tape the DP cable to the base and label it "PRI - CABLE". Ola you have first dibs on the arm.
Kim: I might be able to help carry if Ola needs a hand. Also curious  any chance you have a tiny Allen key for the clamp?
Pri: I have a 4mm Allen, will leave it with the mount.
OfficeBot: :information_source: Reminder: label donated items and remove within 48 hours. Unclaimed items may be moved to the swap shelf after 72 hours.
Ola: Thanks! I can pick up Fri 4:30pm. DM'ing to confirm exact spot.
Ben: I'll grab the cable after lunch if it's still there. Thanks Pri.
Pri: Great, I'll leave the arm on the east bench with a Post-it "PRI - OLA 4:30PM" and the cable taped to the base. If plans change I'll update here. Cheers!
